# ISSUE-520 plan

Remove the unreachable changed-package pre-run implementation while preserving configured-check execution and ordinary reports. Approved dimensions are small / known / standard; compact profile. This fits the 16-hour total claim budget without a split.

## What we know

- `CheckRunOutcome` retains three obsolete fields (`internal/validation/validator.go:85-91`); readers remain in recording/reporting (`:415`, `:426`, `:537`), repair (`internal/validation/repair.go:199`), duration history (`internal/validation/build_cache.go:259,269`), and CLI rendering/filtering (`internal/cli/validate.go:240`, `internal/cli/work_validation.go:31`).
- Dead discovery/selection code shares a file with live helpers: constants at `internal/validation/go_fastpass.go:16`, `fastPassFits` at :79, `goPackage` at :98, `parseGoList` at :113, `affectedPackages` at :172. Preserve `parseGoTestAll`, `safeShellRune`, `goIgnoredDir`, `validImportPath`, `boundedBuffer`, `goCapture` and their dependencies.
- Existing configured-check coverage is mixed into `internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go:109-404`; parser and capture coverage at :442 and :523 remain live. Only tests at :405, :479, :503 exclusively cover removed helpers.
- CLI entry-point coverage at `internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go:16` exercises issue work, validate, submit with a scripted Go executable. Its expected preliminary-pass flag is already false for every entry point.
- Ordinary report coverage includes outcome counts, progress, timing JSON round trips and artifact summaries (`internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go:134-203,318-339`).
- Repository-wide text search found symbol consumers only in the files listed below; no docs/templates depend on these symbols. `rg` is unavailable; use `grep`.

## What we're assuming

No production assignment of these fields exists: repository-wide reference search supports this; verify again against the implementation diff. The source snapshot lacks Git metadata (`git status` fails), so approved-base object inspection is unavailable. No new source file is proposed; the rename destination `internal/cli/configured_checks_test.go` is absent in the supplied snapshot. The developer must verify that destination against the approved base before renaming.

## Open questions

None blocks implementation. This is code deletion, not new runtime behavior or harness capability. Existing fixtures use trusted-local execution and mock CLI agents on the current Unix host (`internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go:35`, `internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go:47`). Native/OCI execution routing remains unchanged; no live service, browser, or new backend verification is needed.

## Implementation sequence

1. In `internal/validation/go_fastpass.go`, delete the two maxFastPass constants and four dead symbols listed above; remove imports made unused by deletion. Leave live helpers and behavior untouched. Keep this filename to avoid unnecessary movement.
2. Remove `Preliminary`, `Packages`, `FallbackReason` from `CheckRunOutcome`. Simplify recording to Passed-only skip aggregation, ordinary PASS/FAIL/limit rendering, and timing copies without the removed field. Simplify repair, duration-history guards, CLI check rendering and failure filtering at the references above. Preserve required-check scheduling, command rewriting for JSON capture, timeout/cache behavior, fencing, and trusted policy selection.
3. In `internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go`, delete only reverse-dependency selection, fit-limit and unsafe go-list metadata tests. Remove obsolete field assertions from surviving tests; retain their command, count, status, progress, JSON and artifact assertions and shared fixtures. Update `internal/validation/go_test_cache_test.go:25,43` similarly. In `internal/validation/build_cache_test.go:753`, remove fabricated preliminary/fallback cases while retaining failed-run exclusion, successful sample storage and existing complete-run coverage (:820).
4. Rename `internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go` to `internal/cli/configured_checks_test.go`; rename the test to `TestConfiguredCheckEntryPoints`. Remove metadata/go-list fixture scaffolding and preliminary/fast flags. Assert the complete invocation log is exactly `test -json ./...\n` for each of work, validate and submit, preserving submission acceptance setup. In `internal/cli/work_progress_test.go:305`, replace the obsolete fabricated skip case with ordinary PASS/FAIL renderer assertions, retaining failure details; the generic name-printing test at :289 may remain unchanged.
5. Format touched Go files and execute TEST_PLAN.md checks. Inspect the diff to confirm only unreachable cases disappeared and normal report/JSON field tags and formatting stayed unchanged.

## HANDOFF

This handoff is evidence to verify against source, not authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Entry points and symbols: `CheckRunOutcome` and recorder/timing projection (`internal/validation/validator.go:72,415,537`); dead helpers (`internal/validation/go_fastpass.go:16,79,98,113,172`); repair loop (`internal/validation/repair.go:199`); `recordRequiredDurations` (`internal/validation/build_cache.go:254`); `writeValidationChecks` (`internal/cli/validate.go:230`); `writeWorkValidationFailure` (`internal/cli/work_validation.go:23`).
- Fixtures/tests: retain `setupGoFastPassRepo` and shared fixtures (`internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go:20,43`), parser/capture tests (:442,523), configured execution tests (:109-404), cache tests, duration-history tests, and the CLI entry-point fixture (:16). No new source files; one existing test file is renamed after approved-base destination verification.
- Exact verification commands are in TEST_PLAN.md: build, vet, symbol grep, validation-package tests and targeted CLI tests. Do not run a single CLI test file alone; it needs package fixtures.
- Checked assumptions: repository-wide grep confirms consumers; source inspection confirms live parser/capture/repair use and existing no-pre-run assertions. No production changes or tests were executed during planning.
- Reopen the plan if a producer of the removed fields is discovered, a live caller of deleted helpers appears, or normal report/JSON behavior would need changing. Do not widen into validation scheduling or harness changes.
- **What this change breaks:** obsolete field initializers/assertions in `internal/validation/go_fastpass_test.go:122-362`, `go_test_cache_test.go:25,43`, `build_cache_test.go:753`, and `internal/cli/work_progress_test.go:310-312` require the focused updates above. Helper-only tests at `go_fastpass_test.go:405,479,503` are deleted with their implementations; live parser/capture tests are preserved. CLI test filename/name and misleading commentary at `internal/cli/go_fastpass_test.go:13-16` are updated; no external references were found. Production readers listed above are simplified, all remaining callers and docs/templates are preserved unchanged.

# ISSUE-520 test plan

## Acceptance mapping

| Criterion | Concrete verification |
| --- | --- |
| 1: build/vet succeed and removed symbols/fields have no references | `go build ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `grep -RnE 'Preliminary|FallbackReason|fastPassFits|affectedPackages|parseGoList' internal` must print nothing and exit 1 (exit 2 is an error). Also search for `maxFastPass` and `goPackage` with identifier boundaries; inspect CheckRunOutcome to confirm its Packages field and obsolete JSON tags are gone. |
| 2: configured-only validation and CLI entry points still pass | `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/validation -count=1`; `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/cli -run '^Test(ConfiguredCheckEntryPoints|ValidationChecksShowConfiguredChecks|WorkProgressNamesChangedPackagePass)$' -count=1`. Rename the updated renderer test to TestValidationChecksShowConfiguredChecks. Preserve the entry-point test's work/validate/submit sequence and require exact invocation logs. |
| Constraint: ordinary reports/JSON and required execution unchanged | Preserve validation outcome counts, exact command/progress assertions, timing JSON round-trip and artifact-summary assertions in existing validation tests; preserve parser/capture, cache, repair and duration-history coverage. Updated CLI renderer asserts exact ordinary PASS/FAIL output including failing tests/output tail. Independently inspect ordinary JSON field tags and report strings in the diff; removed fields were omitted on ordinary zero-valued runs. |

## Developer-owned focused checks

Run the commands above after implementation and gofmt touched Go files. Keep existing live-helper and adversarial tests intact. Package tests include existing configured-only behavior and shared helper/repair/cache consumers; no new broad test suite is required. Record commands, exit statuses, durations, skips and output in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`, with the candidate commit/tree or source diff identity. If Git metadata is unavailable, record that limitation and a digest manifest of touched source files. Record unavailable dependencies/toolchains as limitations; do not use external network.

Expected durations: build and vet each 1–5 minutes with prepared caches; each focused test command at most 5 minutes. If a focused check times out, record the failure and determine the relevant cause before repeating; do not silently broaden tests or weaken assertions.

## Tester-owned independent review

Review the implementation against both acceptance criteria and the no-behavior-change constraint. Confirm every deleted function has no live callers, all three fields and their branches are removed, and preserved helpers and required-check execution paths are unchanged. Inspect the renamed CLI test for exact logs for all three commands; inspect retained validation tests for outcome/progress/report assertions. Confirm grep has no matches, not a command error. Review successful developer evidence and source identity and reuse applicable results. Rerun a focused command only for relevant source changes, observed failures, missing evidence or an unresolved coverage concern. Document review and reused evidence in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`.

## Coordinator-owned policy reference

The coordinator alone runs the complete trusted-base required policy once on the final candidate after roles finish. The compiled policy is a reference, not a developer/tester checklist. Agent observations are advisory and cannot satisfy claim-bound validation or publication.

Checks potentially exceeding five minutes have exactly one owner: coordinator. The full required-policy run (commands/timeouts as compiled in SYSTEM_PROMPT.md, notably CLI regressions up to 30 minutes and core regressions up to 10 minutes) is expected to take 10–45 minutes overall. Evidence belongs in the coordinator's claim-bound validation artifacts/logs, bound to the final candidate tree and approved policy/base. Publication and subsequent roles reuse that evidence while those identities remain applicable; reruns require relevant changes, failures or unresolved coverage concerns.

VERDICT: APPROVED

## Non-blocking notes

- Step 3 keeps the validation tests under their `TestGoFastPass*` names. The acceptance criteria only require the CLI file to be renamed, so this is fine. Renaming them is optional cleanup.
- Simplify `recordRequiredDurations` (`build_cache.go:259,269`) to check `Passed` only. Keep its early return when any check failed.
